request.name: List scopes for a security domain

description.content: User must have the DOMAIN_SCOPE[LIST] permission on the specified domain or DOMAIN_SCOPE[LIST] permission on the specified environment or DOMAIN_SCOPE[LIST] permission on the specified organization Each returned scope is filtered and contains only basic information such as id, key, name, description, isSystem and isDiscovery.
